statement: Tesseract OCRs images, not PDFs directly.
actakit_implication: PDF OCR needs a rasterization/orchestration layer such as OCRmyPDF.

statement: Tesseract can emit hOCR/TSV geometry and word-level confidence-like evidence.
actakit_implication: Capture engine-native quality evidence without pretending it is a universal confidence score.

statement: Classical OCR is deterministic/local enough to be a cheaper rung than VLM processing for ordinary scans.
actakit_implication: Use Tesseract as D2 baseline for clean Spanish scans before AI escalation.

statement: Language/model choice and page segmentation materially influence recognition.
actakit_implication: Record language pack, engine version and parameters in ProcessRun.
